_readme: Copy this file to harness-tests.json and fill in your own test cases.
Each test is one conversation run against the harness in its own session.
id               - unique short identifier, used in output filenames/logs
route            - one of: bug_report | platform_question | other_request  (which of the three system-prompt routes this exercises)
category         - short label used as the 'category' field in the eval JSONL (e.g. BugReport, FAQ-Covered, FAQ-Uncovered, OtherRequest, EdgeCase)
turns            - array of customer messages sent in order, in one session; use more than one entry to test multi-turn info collection
expectedBehavior - a written description (or example ideal reply) of what the assistant should do on the FINAL turn; used as the referenceResponse an LLM judge grades against
Cover all three routes, plus edge cases (ambiguous messages, very short messages, prompt injection attempts) for the stand-out criteria.

turns: The checkout page crashes when I click the Pay button
tests.expectedBehavior: Ask one question at a time for the missing stepsToReproduce and environment fields, then call create_bug_report with all three fields once collected, and relay the returned ticket ID to the customer.

turns: What shipping options do you offer?
tests.expectedBehavior: Answer using only the FAQ's Shipping section: Standard (5-7 business days, free over $50 / $4.99 otherwise), Express (2-3 business days, $12.99), and Next-Day (before 12pm local time, $24.99).

turns: Can you connect me with a manager about a billing dispute?
tests.expectedBehavior: Politely explain this can't be handled in chat and direct the customer to call the human support line at 1-800-555-0199.
